how-21-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the peanuts, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-21-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the peanuts, then tap three things you notice.

how-21-02-compare.page: Put the sieve by one tray and the cup of water by the other: drag them, or tap each one, then tap a tray. Press Test it. Then swap them and press it again.
how-21-02-compare.say: Put the sieve by one tray and the cup of water by the other: drag them, or tap each one, then tap a tray. Press Test it. Then swap them and press it again.

how-21-02-det.page: Pick 3 cards, one at a time. Tap a clue you see, then pick what it is. Predict seed or spore, and watch its home appear.
how-21-02-det.say: Pick three cards, one at a time. Tap a clue you see, then pick what it is. Predict seed or spore, and watch its home appear.

how-21-02-partc.page: Draw a seed and a spore cluster side by side. Label a part of the seed, and the spores.
how-21-02-partc.say: Draw a seed and a spore cluster side by side. Label a part of the seed, and the spores.
